pages.text: $(info)The $(water)Irrigator$() is an agricultural machine that keeps surrounding farmland hydrated automatically - no pond digging required, just redstone and pipes. It covers a $(water)radius of 8 blocks$() around itself and serves the nearest $(water)20 farmland blocks$() by distance; both values are configurable. $()

$(info)Water Storage$()$(br)Holds up to $(water)100 buckets$() of water. $(br)$(item)Water bucket$() right-click: store 1 bucket. $(br)$(item)Empty bucket$() right-click: draw 1 bucket. $(br)$(item)Any other item$() right-click: open the water gauge, a blue-and-white bar with one notch per bucket. $(br)$(br)Attach pipes on top to fill or drain automatically (works with Create, Thermal, and other fluid mods).

$(info)Status Light$()$(br)$(crop)Green$(): powered and watering. $(br)$(warn)Red$(): powered but out of water. $(br)Dark: no redstone signal, standing by. $(br)$(br)$(info)Water Use$(): $(water)1 bucket$() lasts $(water)2 Minecraft days$() (configurable); it only consumes water when crops are actually served, and stops entirely without redstone.

$(info)Irrigation Effect$()$(br)While working, served farmland receives a short burst of raindrops every 5 seconds, like a sprinkler shower. $(br)$(br)$(info)Ecosystem$(): maids recognize the irrigation range and stop watering by hand; JADE correctly reports crop thirst. $(br)$(warn)Note$(): crafting requires 4 cauldrons, 1 water bucket, 2 glass blocks and 2 iron ingots.

pages.title: The Water Gauge
pages.text: Right-click with an empty hand or any non-bucket item to open a $(water)horizontal blue-and-white gauge$(): blue from the left is the water you have, white is the empty space, and $(bold)a full tank is all blue$(). Each notch means $(thing)1 bucket$(), with a darker notch every 10.$(br2)Hover over the bar for the $(info)current amount and total capacity$(), both in buckets and exact numbers. Press $(bold)E$() or $(bold)ESC$() to leave - E simply closes the gauge without opening your inventory.

pages.title: Power, Pipes & Placement
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Redstone$(): a lever, redstone block or clock all work; losing power stops it instantly (dark casing).$(li)$(item)Pipes$(): only the $(bold)top face$() accepts fluid pipes for filling or draining, compatible with Create, Thermal and others.$(li)$(item)Status light$(): green = working, red = powered but empty, dark = standby.$(br2)For a huge field, place several machines at staggered spots: $(bold)each one serves its own nearest 20 plots$(), quotas do not merge.$(br2)In creative, find it under $(item)Functional Blocks$(), or use $(thing)/give @s seedseasons:irrigator$(). While working, its plots get a burst of raindrops every $(thing)5 seconds$().
